source.contentAnchor: 서술형 2: D가 AC의 중점, AB=8, ∠C=90°, ∠A=60°일 때 BD의 길이
source.sourceSolutionConclusion: AC=4, BC=4√3, CD=2이고 BD=√(BC²+CD²)=2√13

requiredVisual.directVisualObservation: Right triangle ABC has the right-angle marker at C, ∠A=60°, AB=8, and matching tick marks show D is the midpoint of AC.

results.difficultyReason: 60° 삼각비로 AC와 BC를 구하고, 중점 조건으로 CD를 얻은 뒤 작은 직각삼각형에 피타고라스 정리를 적용하는 복합 서술형이다.

independentEvidence.derivation: AC=AB cos60°=4 and BC=AB sin60°=4√3. Since D is the midpoint of AC, CD=2. Triangle BCD is right at C, so BD²=(4√3)²+2²=52 and BD=2√13.
independentEvidence.sourceSolutionIndependentAudit: PASS: the visual midpoint condition and the source numerical conclusion agree with the independent calculation.
independentEvidence.visualRequirementIndependentAudit: PASS: the selected source PNG was directly inspected and its right-angle, 60°, length, and midpoint markers support the solve.

source.contentAnchor: 서술형 3: 두 삼각형 ABC와 ADE가 겹쳐지고 겹친 부분 ADF의 넓이를 구하는 문제
source.sourceSolutionConclusion: AD=3√2/2, ∠DAF=30°, DF=√6/2, 따라서 넓이 ADF=3√3/4 cm²

requiredVisual.directVisualObservation: The image shows overlapping right triangles with A at the top, AD vertical, DE horizontal, right-angle markers at D and B, F on the overlap boundary, 45° at E, and 60° at C.

results.difficultyReason: 겹친 영역의 위치를 시각적으로 해석하고 두 직각삼각형에서 AD와 DF를 순차적으로 구한 뒤 겹친 삼각형의 넓이를 계산해야 한다.

independentEvidence.derivation: In right triangle ADE, AD=AE sin45°=3√2/2. From the visual and ∠ACB=60°, ∠BAC=30°, so ∠DAF=30°. In right triangle ADF, DF=AD tan30°=√6/2. Thus area ADF=1/2·(3√2/2)·(√6/2)=3√3/4 cm².

independentEvidence.visualRequirementIndependentAudit: PASS: the selected source PNG was directly inspected; right-angle markers, 45°, 60°, and intersection F provide the required diagram evidence.

source.sourceSolutionConclusion: C=90°이므로 AB=c, BC=a, AC=b이고 sin A=a/c만 옳으므로 정답은 ①

requiredVisual.directVisualObservation: The image shows right angle C, hypotenuse AB labeled c, side BC labeled a, and side AC labeled b, with angle A marked.

independentEvidence.derivation: With C=90°, AB=c is the hypotenuse. Relative to A, BC=a is opposite and AC=b is adjacent, so sin A=a/c, cos A=b/c, and tan A=a/b. Relative to B, sin B=b/c and cos B=a/c.

④ false: cos B=a/c

source.sourceSolutionConclusion: DB=9, CD=12, BC=15에서 AD=16, AB=25, AC=20이므로 cos A=4/5, 정답은 ②

requiredVisual.directVisualObservation: The image shows A-D-B collinear, CD perpendicular to AB, DB=9, CD=12, and BC=15, with the right-angle markers needed for the altitude construction.

results.difficultyReason: 빗변에 내린 수선으로 생긴 직각삼각형의 닮음으로 AD를 복원하고 AB·AC를 차례로 계산해야 하는 다단계 문제다.

independentEvidence.derivation: From the altitude theorem, AD·DB=CD², so AD·9=144 and AD=16. Therefore AB=16+9=25. In right triangle ACD, AC=√(16²+12²)=20, hence cos A=AC/AB=20/25=4/5.

② 4/5 equals AC/AB

results.difficultyReason: 같은 중심거리에서 같은 현을 이끌어 내고 삼각형의 밑각을 구한 뒤, 두 직각을 포함한 사각형의 내각합으로 중심각을 계산하는 연쇄 추론이다.

independentEvidence.derivation: Equal center-to-chord distances give equal chords AB=AC. Hence triangle ABC is isosceles, so ∠B=∠C=55° and ∠A=70°. In quadrilateral AMON, ∠AMO=∠ANO=90°, so ∠MON=360°−70°−90°−90°=110°.
